domains.definition: Factual explanatory, news, travel, civic, cultural, and practical informational prose that is not drawn from prior WMT or Gamma development material.
Non-patient public-health and medical information spanning instructions, risk communication, terminology, negation, dosage-like numbers, and uncertainty.
Natural assistant requests and responses spanning everyday tasks, scheduling, travel, commerce, media, home, and device interactions.

roles.sourcePolicy: Use only human-approved, role-assigned rows from the exact public candidates. Public visibility is acceptable because calibration cannot select or promote a model.
roles.access: Visible under a predeclared calibration look budget; forbidden for training, row curation, checkpoint selection, and promotion claims.
roles.lookBudget: One baseline/comparator calibration pass and one human-rubric calibration pass after manifest freeze.

roles.sourcePolicy: Newly commissioned source and reference material from a source, author, vendor, document, and template family disjoint from every other role and all training data.
roles.custodian: Gamma evaluator/selector separate from trainers and data curators
roles.access: Rows remain hidden until all lane artifacts for a declared look are committed. Predictions and aggregate receipts may be returned; source/reference bytes remain evaluator-only.
roles.lookBudget: Exactly the look count frozen by the matched run contract; every attempted look is recorded and failures consume a look unless predeclared infrastructure recovery applies.

roles.sourcePolicy: Newly commissioned source and reference material from a second source, author, vendor, document, and template family disjoint from training, calibration, selection, and promotion.
roles.custodian: Gamma confirmation evaluator separate from trainers, curators, and the recipe selector
roles.access: One evaluation for each frozen seed after the recipe, checkpoint rule, decode policy, and seed identities are committed.
roles.lookBudget: One complete pass for each of seeds 11, 29, and 47; no row-level feedback returns before all three receipts seal.

roles.sourcePolicy: Newly commissioned source and reference material from a third independent source, author, vendor, document, and template family, created after this contract freeze and never made public before terminal evaluation.
roles.custodian: External promotion custodian with no training, curation, selection, conversion, or hosting role
roles.access: No source, reference, row metadata, or per-item result enters the ordinary Gamma, Doppler, or agent workspace. The custodian returns only the frozen aggregate and permitted audit receipt.
roles.lookBudget: One committed exact hosted Doppler artifact, one use. A valid quality failure consumes the population.

contentPolicy.nativeSourceAuthorship: English sources are authored natively for en-es; Spanish sources are authored natively for es-en.
contentPolicy.referenceCreation: Each reference is produced by an independent qualified professional translator with context and then quality-controlled by a second bilingual reviewer.
contentPolicy.modelInvolvement: No candidate, comparator, teacher, frontier model, or machine translation output may author, translate, select, rewrite, or quality-control evaluation rows.
contentPolicy.privacy: No personal, patient, privileged, confidential, or production-customer data.

rightsPolicy.requiredGrant: Written rights must cover evaluation, blinded review, internal reproducibility storage, hashing, comparator processing, and use of aggregate results in commercial and public claims.
rightsPolicy.publication: The manifest declares whether source/reference text, predictions, and limited examples may be published. Lack of redistribution rights does not permit publishing protected text.
rightsPolicy.attribution: Every source, author, translator, reviewer, vendor, and upstream license receives the attribution required by its signed receipt without exposing sealed rows.
rightsPolicy.humanApproval: A named human owner signs a source-and-rights receipt before any row is materialized or viewed by Gamma.

custodyPolicy.roleSeparation: Trainer, teacher, curator, selector, evaluator, reviewer, adjudicator, converter, host, and promotion custodian identities and denied role combinations are receipt-bound.
custodyPolicy.promotion: Promotion encryption keys, raw bytes, mappings, and item results remain solely with the external custodian until a terminal receipt exists.
custodyPolicy.accessLog: Every read, prediction submission, retry, failure, export, and aggregate disclosure records actor, role, artifact hash, population hash, event type, and sequence number.
custodyPolicy.failure: Unauthorized access, unknown overlap, identity mismatch, model-assisted row creation, or an extra look invalidates the affected population and requires a replacement contract.
